svg.title: llama3_fast_attention: task architecture
svg.desc: Root-owned validation, query distribution and output draining connect the four direct task groups through the complete local transfer inventory and named public ports.

g.text: Functional/task ownership; not an implied RTL partition or cycle schedule

svg.text: Named frame ports separate external IO from internal handoffs. Local junction ≠ child function. Hops mark crossings without a connection.
FIFO depths shown are configured capacities, not proven minimum depths. Data types and multiplicity follow the local contract.
